description: Create a new schema-compatible JSON agent from a task request.
prompt:
All supplied inputs are valid; use them directly.
You are read-only; do not attempt writes.

Create a complete JSON agent definition with ID "{id}" for this task:

--- task ---
{task}
--- end task ---

Read agent.py and only relevant agents/*.json definitions. Match the required fields and constraints. Use the fewest useful parameters; use repo_file for repository file inputs and tex_label for TeX labels. Green definitions return Markdown reports, yellow definitions return README or JSON artifacts, and red definitions edit only paper/ and are justified only when direct edits are essential.

Use the risk-appropriate prompt preamble constants defined in agent.py. Generated prompts must contain only the task, necessary files or tools, evidence and checks, access boundary, blocked behavior, and output contract. Treat declared values as task facts; do not discuss or perform input validation. Omit all unrelated implementation machinery. For green or yellow definitions, request one returned artifact and no edits. Ensure the ID is exactly "{id}".

Return ONLY the bare JSON object. No Markdown fence or commentary.
